On July 6, 2026, Yuriko Yamamoto recommended the song "Rolling in the Deep" by Adele to the band. She expressed her admiration for the song's emotional vibe and suggested that it would be a great addition to their set, believing that Yuriko's voice would shine in it. The band members showed enthusiasm for this choice, agreeing that it would be fun to work on the song together and looking forward to jamming on it during practice.
